$fixture.notes: Relaxing a boundary restores authority. The actor may not restore authority they do not themselves hold — a delegation-ceiling rule applied to boundary removal. Distinct from MUTATION_PERMISSION_LOST: here the actor never had the authority; there they had it and the mutation took it away mid-flight. The matching preview is preview-delete-response.json, whose commitBlocked carries this same code with an empty _capabilities.actions.

error.message: You cannot restore authority you do not hold.

details.remedy: Ask a principal who holds agent.delete and role_binding.create in Atlas to commit this change, or narrow the relaxation to permissions you hold.
